control_service_filename.description: Path to the Unix domain socket for the control service.

control_service_permissions.description: File permissions for the control service socket (octal string).

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting. Set to true only when diagnosing issues.

listener.description: Network listener configuration for incoming peer connections.

max_conns.description: Maximum number of concurrent inbound connections allowed.

nodes.description: List of mesh nodes (other Receptor instances). At least one peer is required for a functional mesh.

result_ttl.description: Time-to-live (seconds) for work results stored in the state directory.

state_dir.description: Directory where Receptor stores persistent node state, completed work results, and metadata.

tcp_listener_port.description: TCP port for the mesh listener.

tls.description: TLS/SSL certificate and key configuration for secure mesh communication.

work_command_allowruntimeparams.description: Whether runtime parameters can be passed to the work command.

work_command_command.description: Command to execute for local work items.

work_command_params.description: Arguments passed to the work command.

work_dir.description: Directory for temporary files and transient worker data.

workers.description: List of workers (named job executors) that accept work from the mesh.
